caption: Sold per day is the average of the last {days} days. Status compares the runs-out date with the default supplier's lead time.

tiles.reservedSub: Held for paid and requested orders

waiting.title: {n, plural, one {# paid order is waiting for stock} other {# paid orders are waiting for stock}}
waiting.canAllocate: There is stock for at least the oldest one. Allocate to make it ready to send.
waiting.notYet: Not enough stock yet. Allocate when the next purchase arrives.

allocate.title: Allocate
allocate.sub: {n, plural, one {# order waiting} other {# orders waiting}}
allocate.done: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing allocated} one {# order allocated. Its agent is told.} other {# orders allocated. Their agents are told.}}
allocate.short: Not enough {flavours} for every ticked order. Untick one to continue.
allocate.consequence: Ticked orders become Paid · ready to send and their agents are told. Unticked orders keep their place in the queue.
allocate.emptyText: Every paid order has its stock.

adjust.title: Stock adjustment
adjust.changeHelp: Use minus for cartons that left the stock, plus for cartons found.
adjust.consequence: Written to stock movements and the audit log.

movements.emptyText: Receipts, dispatches, returns and adjustments show here, newest first.

counts.title: Count of {date}
counts.help: The warehouse counts blind. Each count shows here with what the system expected, so you can correct the difference.
counts.banner: {n, plural, one {# stock count from the warehouse needs a check.} other {# stock counts from the warehouse need a check.}}
counts.differences: {n, plural, one {# flavour differs} other {# flavours differ}}
counts.matchesText: The count matches what the system expected. Nothing will change.
counts.correctConsequence: Creates one stock adjustment per flavour for the difference, reason Count difference, and marks the count as checked.
counts.doneAdjusted: {n, plural, one {Stock corrected for # flavour} other {Stock corrected for # flavours}}
counts.emptyText: Counts sent from the warehouse show here for checking.
